content: LNBits withdraw extension key features: Quick Vouchers (batch same-amount LNURL-w, printable QR), Advanced LNURLw (variable min/max, scan count, time gate, unique-QR rotation), custom SVG template support, LNBits-wallet-creation on scan for walletless recipients. No email, no expiry date enforcement, no recipient metadata, no design gallery. Satoshi Engineering TipCards wraps LNBits: adds card set management, funded/viewed/redeemed status per card, withdraw remaining sats. No CSV import. This new gift cards extension would fill the gap: email delivery, CSV bulk, design templates, expiry, issuer dashboard — all things current LNBits primitives lack.
